  3. Call `always_unfold(ex, lift_action(next))` → get `∀i, next(ex.suffix(i).head(), ex.suffix(i).head_next())`.
  4. For each `i`, call `init_invariant_rec(ex, init, next, inv, i)` → get `inv(ex.suffix(i).head())`.
